assertions: generated Rust client and server bindings compile from the checked-in proto subset
a generated client reaches the generated server over HTTP/2
the listener is disabled unless an explicit bind address is configured
non-loopback binding uses the same explicit opt-in as the HTTP listener
HTTP and gRPC listeners cannot use the same address
drain and gRPC failure use the shared process lifecycle fence
limitations: Only Nakama Healthcheck is represented; every other RPC remains outside this subset.
The google.api HTTP annotation is recorded but grpc-gateway is not generated or served.
No immutable Nakama differential or official SDK black-box result is accepted.
No TLS, reflection, load, HA, cross-node or production evidence is claimed for the gRPC listener.
Independent protocol and security review remain mandatory.
